text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Skim Felda) (Pindaan) 2017.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 25 Oktober 2017.

Pindaan Jadual

2. Perintah Jalan Persekutuan (Skim Felda) 1991 [P.U. (A) 449/1991] dipinda dalam

Jadual di bawah kepala "Negeri Terengganu" dengan memasukkan selepas butiran

"Neram 2" dan butir-butir yang berhubungan dengannya butiran dan butir-butir yang

berikut:

JADUAL

NEGERI TERENGGANU

Nama Skim Nombor Laluan Jalan Masuk Jalan Kampung

FELDA Bagi Jalan Masuk (km) (km)

"Neram 1 (Tambahan) 3.825 2.449".

Dibuat 13 Oktober 2017

[KKR.PUU.110-1/6/11 Jld.3; PN(PU2)391/XXXIV]

DATO' SRI HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Menteri Kerja Raya

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat menurut seksyen 4 Akta Jalan Persekutuan 1959]

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (FELDA SCHEME) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959 [Act 376],

the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Terengganu, makes the

following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Felda Scheme)

(Amendment) Order 2017.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 25 October 2017.

Amendment of Schedule

2. The Federal Roads (Felda Scheme) Order 1991 [P.U. (A) 449/1991] is amended in

the Schedule under the heading "Negeri Terengganu" by inserting after item "Neram 2"

and the particulars relating to it the following item and the particulars relating to it:

SCHEDULE

NEGERI TERENGGANU

Name of Scheme Route Number Entrance Rural Route

FELDA of the Entrance (km) (km)

"Neram 1 (Tambahan) 3.825 2.449".

Made 13 October 2017

[KKR.PUU.110-1/6/11 Jld.3; PN(PU2)391/XXXIV]

DATO' SRI HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Minister of Works

[To be laid before the Dewan Rakyat pursuant to section 4 of the Federal Roads Act 1959]
